# Toolioz — Developer Utilities, PDF Tools & Financial Calculators

> Toolioz (https://toolioz.com) is a privacy-first web utility suite. All PDF manipulation, cryptographic hashing, data conversion, and financial calculations run 100% client-side in the user's browser using WebAssembly, Web Workers, and HTML5 Canvas. Zero user files, inputs, or personal documents are uploaded to or stored on servers.

## PDF Document Utilities (100% Client-Side, No File Uploads)

Local PDF manipulation using pdf-lib and pdfjs-dist. All processing occurs in the browser memory.

- [PDF Merge Tool](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/merge-pdf): Combines PDF files in the chosen order. The files stay in the browser.
- [PDF to Image Converter](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/pdf-to-image): Renders each PDF page as a PNG or JPEG in the browser.
- [Image to PDF Converter](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/image-to-pdf): Combines JPG, PNG, and WebP images into one PDF in the browser.
- [Split PDF & Extract Pages](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/split-pdf): Extracts selected pages or ranges with pdf-lib. The PDF is not uploaded.
- [Organize PDF](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/organize-pdf): Reorders, rotates, and removes PDF pages, with the file kept in the browser.
- [Add PDF Page Numbers](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/add-page-numbers-to-pdf): Adds page numbers with pdf-lib. The PDF is not uploaded.
- [Watermark PDF](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/watermark-pdf): Draws centered Helvetica text on each page. Size, opacity, and angle can change. The color is fixed, and the PDF is not uploaded.
- [PDF Metadata Editor](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/pdf-metadata-editor): Reads and writes PDF title, author, subject, keywords, creator, and producer with pdf-lib. The file is not uploaded.
- [PDF to Text](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/pdf-to-text): Extracts selectable text with pdf.js, one block per page. A scanned page returns no text. The PDF is not uploaded.
- [Bates Numbering PDF](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/bates-numbering-pdf): Stamps a prefix, a zero-padded number, and a suffix in Helvetica on each page. The PDF is not uploaded.
- [Remove Blank Pages](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/remove-blank-pages): Detects and removes empty or blank pages from a PDF with an adjustable sensitivity slider. Processed 100% in your browser.
- [Letter ↔ A4](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/letter-to-a4): Resize PDF pages between US Letter and ISO A4 dimensions with proportional scaling. The file is not uploaded.
- [Split by Bookmarks](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/split-pdf-by-bookmarks): Splits a PDF into separate chapter files using document outline bookmarks. Processing stays in your browser.
- [Reverse PDF Pages](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/reverse-pdf-pages): Reverses the sequence of pages in a PDF document in one click. 100% private in-browser processing.
- [Add Blank Pages](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/add-blank-page-after-page): Interleaves an empty blank page after every page of your PDF for double-sided printing or note taking.
- [2 Pages Per Sheet](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/2-pages-per-sheet): Combines two PDF pages side-by-side onto a single sheet for compact reading and booklet printing.
- [Flatten PDF](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/flatten-pdf): Flattens interactive form fields and removes annotations to prevent accidental edits or disclosure.
- [ATS Resume Generator](https://toolioz.com/resume-builder): Create polished resumes with a live LaTeX editor and text-based PDF export.

## Developer, Data & Subtitle Utilities

Formatters, encoders, converters (JSON, CSV, KML, GPX, XML, TypeScript), and WebVTT caption utilities.

- [JSON Formatter](https://toolioz.com/devtools/json-formatter): Formats, validates, and minifies JSON, and can emit YAML or TypeScript.
- [Base64 Converter](https://toolioz.com/devtools/base64-converter): Encode and decode strings to and from Base64 format.
- [JWT Decoder](https://toolioz.com/devtools/jwt-decoder): Decode, verify and inspect JSON Web Tokens securely.
- [Cron Generator](https://toolioz.com/devtools/cron-generator): Generate, parse and explain cron expression schedules.
- [RegExp Tester](https://toolioz.com/devtools/regex-tester): Test and debug Regular Expressions with live highlighting.
- [URL Encoder](https://toolioz.com/devtools/url-encoder): Encode and decode URLs or URI components instantly.
- [Bcrypt Generator](https://toolioz.com/devtools/bcrypt-generator): Generate and verify Bcrypt password hashes securely.
- [Hash Generator](https://toolioz.com/devtools/hash-generator): Generate SHA hashes for text or files using Web Crypto APIs.
- [cURL Converter](https://toolioz.com/devtools/curl-converter): Convert cURL commands into Fetch, Axios, and Python snippets.
- [Timestamp Converter](https://toolioz.com/devtools/timestamp-converter): Convert Unix seconds, milliseconds, and date strings instantly.
- [JSON Diff Checker](https://toolioz.com/devtools/json-diff): Compare two JSON payloads and inspect exact field-level changes.
- [UUID Generator](https://toolioz.com/devtools/uuid-generator): Generate secure v4 UUIDs in bulk effortlessly.
- [YAML ↔ JSON](https://toolioz.com/devtools/yaml-json-converter): Converts YAML to JSON with yaml.load, or JSON to YAML with yaml.dump. A parse error is shown.
- [XML Formatter](https://toolioz.com/devtools/xml-formatter-validator): Formats XML with DOMParser and shows the browser parsererror text when the markup is invalid.
- [JSON Schema Validator](https://toolioz.com/devtools/json-schema-validator): Checks JSON data with AJV against a JSON Schema and lists each error path and message.
- [HTTP Status Lookup](https://toolioz.com/devtools/http-status-code-lookup): Search common HTTP response codes by number, name, category, or meaning.
- [MIME Type Lookup](https://toolioz.com/devtools/mime-type-lookup): Find common MIME media types from a file extension or content type.
- [UTM Builder](https://toolioz.com/devtools/utm-builder): Adds utm_source, utm_medium, and utm_campaign to an absolute URL with URLSearchParams. Term and content are optional.
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://toolioz.com/devtools/robots-txt-generator): Writes a robots.txt with a user-agent, Allow and Disallow lines, and an optional sitemap URL.
- [Hreflang Generator](https://toolioz.com/devtools/hreflang-generator): Writes one alternate link tag per language and URL pair. It does not add the reverse tags.
- [Schema Markup Generator](https://toolioz.com/devtools/schema-markup-generator): Builds FAQ, HowTo, or Product JSON-LD. A schema.org validator is not run.
- [HTML Encode / Decode](https://toolioz.com/devtools/html-encoder-decoder): Encodes &, <, >, and quotes. Decoding also accepts numeric character references. The text stays in the page.
- [Slug Generator](https://toolioz.com/devtools/slug-generator): Turn a title into a lowercase hyphenated URL slug, stripping accents and punctuation.
- [chmod Calculator](https://toolioz.com/devtools/chmod-calculator): Turns read, write, and execute checkboxes into a 3-digit octal mode and an rwx string. The command has no filename.
- [CSV ↔ JSON](https://toolioz.com/devtools/csv-json-converter): Converts a headered CSV to JSON objects, or an array of objects to CSV. Cell values stay strings.
- [CSV to Markdown](https://toolioz.com/devtools/csv-to-markdown-table): Converts CSV or tab-separated data into aligned GitHub-flavored Markdown tables. Kept 100% in your browser.
- [NDJSON to CSV](https://toolioz.com/devtools/ndjson-to-csv): Converts newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON / JSONL) files into clean tabular CSV with automatic header detection.
- [XML to CSV](https://toolioz.com/devtools/xml-to-csv): Flattens XML elements and repeating record trees into tabular CSV format for spreadsheets. 100% private in-browser.
- [JSON to TypeScript](https://toolioz.com/devtools/json-to-typescript): Generates clean TypeScript interfaces and type definitions from JSON data. Processed client-side.
- [SRT ↔ VTT](https://toolioz.com/devtools/srt-to-vtt): Converts between SubRip (.srt) and WebVTT (.vtt) caption formats instantly in your browser with zero uploads.
- [Subtitle to Text](https://toolioz.com/devtools/subtitle-to-text): Extracts clean dialogue and plain text transcripts from SRT or VTT subtitle files, stripping timestamps and formatting tags.
- [Subtitle Time Shift](https://toolioz.com/devtools/subtitle-time-shift): Sync out-of-time subtitles by adding or subtracting milliseconds and adjusting frame rates (23.976, 24, 25, 29.97 fps).
- [GPX ↔ KML](https://toolioz.com/devtools/gpx-to-kml): Converts GPS tracks and waypoints between GPX and Google Earth KML format with zero server uploads.
- [GeoJSON to KML](https://toolioz.com/devtools/geojson-to-kml): Converts GeoJSON features (Points, LineStrings, Polygons) to Google Earth KML placemarks client-side.
- [CSV to KML](https://toolioz.com/devtools/csv-to-kml): Converts tabular spreadsheet coordinates (latitude, longitude, name) into Google Earth KML placemarks.
- [CSS Clamp Generator](https://toolioz.com/devtools/css-clamp-generator): Builds clamp() fluid type and spacing, with a modular type-scale tab.
- [PX to REM Converter](https://toolioz.com/devtools/px-to-rem-converter): Converts pixels to rem and em at a chosen root font size, with a common-size table.
- [Tailwind Color Generator](https://toolioz.com/devtools/tailwind-color-generator): Builds 50–950 OKLCH shades and Tailwind v4 @theme tokens from a seed hex.
- [Snowflake Parser](https://toolioz.com/tools/snowflakes): Shifts a Discord snowflake 22 bits and adds the 2015 Discord epoch. The id is not sent to Discord.
- [CSS Minifier](https://toolioz.com/tools/css-minifier): Compress CSS to reduce file size.
- [JS Minifier](https://toolioz.com/tools/js-minifier): Minify and clean JavaScript code.
- [HTML Minifier](https://toolioz.com/tools/html-minifier): Optimize HTML structure.
- [Barcode Generator](https://toolioz.com/tools/barcode-generator): Create custom barcodes (EAN, UPC, etc).
- [SQL Query Generator](https://toolioz.com/tools/sql-query-generator): Visually build SQL queries.
- [SQL Formatter](https://toolioz.com/tools/sql-formatter): Beautify and debug SQL queries.
- [Code to Image](https://toolioz.com/tools/code-to-image): Create beautiful code screenshots.
- [Open Graph Preview](https://toolioz.com/tools/open-graph-preview): Preview pages on social media.
- [Password Generator](https://toolioz.com/tools/password-generator): Builds a password with Math.random from the selected sets. The default length is 16.
- [Meta Tag Generator](https://toolioz.com/tools/meta-tag-generator): Creates title, description, and social meta tags for a page.
- [Diff Checker](https://toolioz.com/tools/diff-checker): Compare two texts and find differences.
- [GitHub Graph Simulator](https://toolioz.com/tools/github-graph-simulator): Visualize merge, rebase, and git flow.

## Financial Engineering & Investment Calculators

Client-side calculators for SIP, compound interest, mortgage prepayment, and financial planning.

- [Compound Interest](https://toolioz.com/finance/compound-interest): Future value with daily, monthly, quarterly, or annual compounding.
- [Mortgage Calc](https://toolioz.com/finance/mortgage-calculator): Monthly mortgage payment, total interest, and payoff for a balance, rate, and term.
- [ROI Calculator](https://toolioz.com/finance/roi-calculator): Measure the profitability of an investment quickly.
- [SIP Calculator](https://toolioz.com/finance/sip-calculator): Wealth generation through systematic monthly investments.
- [Lumpsum Calculator](https://toolioz.com/finance/lumpsum-calculator): Project how a one-time investment can grow with compounding.
- [Fixed Deposit](https://toolioz.com/finance/fd-calculator): Estimate maturity value for a fixed-rate bank deposit.
- [Savings Goal](https://toolioz.com/finance/savings-goal): Monthly deposit that grows a balance to a target by a deadline.
- [Retirement Corpus](https://toolioz.com/finance/retirement-corpus): Corpus that can fund inflation-adjusted spending for a chosen number of years.
- [Inflation Calc](https://toolioz.com/finance/inflation-calculator): Future price and purchasing-power change after a chosen inflation rate and number of years.
- [Loan Prepayment](https://toolioz.com/finance/loan-prepayment): Interest saved and months removed when an extra EMI or principal payment is applied.
- [Car Loan EMI](https://toolioz.com/finance/car-loan): Reducing-balance car-loan EMI, total interest, and total amount payable.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://toolioz.com/finance/percentage-calculator): Find a percentage of a number or what percent one value is of another, with steps.
- [Percentage Change](https://toolioz.com/finance/percentage-change-calculator): Calculate percentage increase or decrease from an original value to a new value.
- [Reverse Percentage](https://toolioz.com/finance/reverse-percentage-calculator): Recover an original amount before a percentage increase or decrease.
- [Discount After Tax](https://toolioz.com/finance/discount-calculator-after-tax): Break down sale savings, tax on the reduced price, and the final amount.

## Design, Canvas & Creative Utilities

In-browser graphics tools, retro dithering, 16:9 split triptychs, and drawing canvases.

- [Background Remover](https://toolioz.com/design/background-remover): Remove simple backgrounds locally, refine with brushes, and export a transparent PNG.
- [Image Compressor](https://toolioz.com/pdftools/image-compressor): Reduce image size with adjustable quality and target-size controls.
- [Drawesome Vector Studio ✦ (by Benji Taylor)](https://toolioz.com/devtools/drawesome): Freehand vector drawing canvas with 7 realistic pens (pencil, ballpoint, fineliner, marker, highlighter, brush, fountain pen), area eraser, and SVG/PNG export.
- [ditherit ✦ Interactive ASCII & Dot Art (by Prasanjit Dey)](https://toolioz.com/devtools/ditherit): Convert images, videos, and GIFs into dithered dot art or ASCII with interactive physics repulsion, WebM export, and React/JS code export.
- [Image & Video Dither Studio](https://toolioz.com/devtools/dither-studio): Apply retro 1-bit, Floyd-Steinberg, Bayer ordered, GameBoy, CGA, and pixel art dithering to images and videos live in browser.
- [WebGL GLSL Shader Studio](https://toolioz.com/devtools/shader-tool): Interactive real-time GLSL fragment shader editor & playground. Live preview, Shadertoy uniforms, raymarching SDFs, presets, and code export.
- [Free Shader Background Generator](https://toolioz.com/devtools/background-generator): Design beautiful animated shader-based background images for wallpapers, social headers, and website hero sections.
- [X Tap-to-Reveal PNG Maker](https://toolioz.com/devtools/x-hidden-image): Tap-to-reveal PNG for X and Twitter. Timeline preview versus opened view, brush masks, PNG8.
- [Split Image in 3](https://toolioz.com/design/split-image-in-3): Crop a photo to 16:9 and split it into 3 equal vertical parts for X, Instagram, and carousels. Client-side PNG export.
- [Color Format Suite](https://toolioz.com/devtools/color-converter): Convert seamlessly between HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK color codes with palette generation.
- [CSS Grid Builder](https://toolioz.com/devtools/layout-generator): Visually build CSS Grid layouts with rows, columns, gaps, and code export.
- [EXIF Viewer & Remover](https://toolioz.com/devtools/exif-viewer-remover): Shows photo metadata. The download strips JPEG EXIF, XMP, IPTC, and comments, or PNG metadata, without re-encoding pixels.
- [Image Dimensions & Ratio](https://toolioz.com/devtools/image-dimensions-aspect-ratio): Reads pixel width and height, simplifies the ratio by the greatest common divisor, and scales one side in proportion.
- [OCR Image to Text](https://toolioz.com/devtools/ocr-image-to-text): Recognizes English text in JPG, PNG, and WebP images, with recognition kept in the browser.
- [Contrast Checker](https://toolioz.com/devtools/color-contrast-checker): Measure the contrast ratio of two hex colors against WCAG AA and AAA text thresholds.
- [Color Blindness Simulator](https://toolioz.com/design/color-blindness-simulator): Simulates protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia on a palette or an uploaded image.
- [PNG to ICO Converter](https://toolioz.com/design/png-to-ico): Packs a PNG into a multi-size .ico with 16, 32, 48, and 256 px layers.
- [SVG to PNG Converter](https://toolioz.com/design/svg-to-png): Rasters an SVG to a transparent PNG at a chosen width in the browser.
- [Photo Print Size Calculator](https://toolioz.com/design/photo-print-size-calculator): Converts pixel dimensions to inches and centimetres at a chosen DPI.
- [Drawing Grid Maker](https://toolioz.com/design/drawing-grid-maker): Overlays a measured grid on a photo for transfer drawing, with print output.
- [Pixel Art from Image](https://toolioz.com/design/pixel-art-from-image): Downsamples a photo to a pixel grid for bead, Minecraft, or cross-stitch planning.
- [Tweet Generator](https://toolioz.com/tools/tweet-generator): Create realistic fake tweet screenshots.
- [Instagram Bio Generator](https://toolioz.com/tools/instagram-bio-generator): Creates styled text for an Instagram bio.
- [Image Converter](https://toolioz.com/tools/image-converter): Draws an image on a canvas and saves PNG, JPEG, or WebP. The file is not uploaded.
- [Image Resizer](https://toolioz.com/tools/image-resizer): Resize images to specific dimensions.
- [Gradient Generator](https://toolioz.com/tools/gradient-generator): Create beautiful CSS gradients.
- [Glassmorphism Generator](https://toolioz.com/tools/css-glassmorphism-generator): Generate CSS glassmorphism effects.
- [Flexbox Playground](https://toolioz.com/tools/flexbox-playground): Interactively learn and test Flexbox.
- [CSS Button Generator](https://toolioz.com/tools/css-button-generator): Design buttons and copy CSS code.
- [Color Palette](https://toolioz.com/tools/color-palette): Generate beautiful color palettes from a base color.
- [Box Shadow Generator](https://toolioz.com/tools/box-shadow-generator): Design CSS box shadows with live preview.
- [Favicon Generator](https://toolioz.com/tools/favicon-generator): Create favicons from emoji or text.

## Gaming, Minecraft, Pokemon & D&D Calculators

Evergreen game math: Minecraft circles and nether portals, FPS sensitivity/eDPI, Pokemon type weaknesses, and D&D 5e dice and encounter XP.

- [Minecraft Circle Generator](https://toolioz.com/minecraft/circle-generator): Maps Minecraft circles and spheres from a diameter. Pixel math does not change with patches.
- [Nether Portal Calculator](https://toolioz.com/minecraft/nether-portal-calculator): Converts Overworld and Nether portal coordinates with the 8:1 Java Edition scale.
- [Shulker Box Calculator](https://toolioz.com/minecraft/shulker-box-calculator): Counts items in Minecraft shulker boxes at stack sizes of 64, 16, or 1.
- [Mouse Sensitivity Converter](https://toolioz.com/gaming/mouse-sensitivity-converter): Converts FPS hipfire sensitivity with eDPI and cm/360 using each game's yaw constant.
- [Pokemon Type Weakness](https://toolioz.com/pokemon/type-weakness-calculator): Dual-type Pokemon weaknesses from the Generation 6 type chart used since 2013.
- [D&D Dice Roller](https://toolioz.com/dnd/dice-roller): Rolls 5e dice notation including advantage, 4d6kh3, and damage plus modifiers.
- [5e Encounter Calculator](https://toolioz.com/dnd/5e-encounter-calculator): Rates D&D 5e encounters with the 2014 Dungeon Master's Guide XP table.

## Makers, Craft, Kitchen, Music & Home Calculators

Client-side knitting, yarn, 3D filament, baking, coffee, BPM, aquarium, lumber, and electronics calculators.

- [Knitting Gauge Calculator](https://toolioz.com/craft/knitting-gauge-calculator): Converts a knitting gauge swatch into cast-on stitches and a pattern adjustment factor.
- [Crochet Gauge Calculator](https://toolioz.com/craft/crochet-gauge-calculator): Converts a crochet gauge swatch into stitch counts and a pattern adjustment factor.
- [Yarn Calculator](https://toolioz.com/craft/yarn-calculator): Estimates yarn grams, yards, and 100 g skeins for a blanket, scarf, or hat.
- [Needle Size Converter](https://toolioz.com/craft/needle-size-converter): Converts knitting needle and crochet hook sizes across millimetres, US, UK, and Japan.
- [Cross Stitch Fabric Calculator](https://toolioz.com/craft/cross-stitch-fabric-calculator): Cuts Aida or evenweave fabric size from stitch counts, fabric count, and over 1 or 2.
- [Quilt Size Calculator](https://toolioz.com/craft/quilt-size-calculator): Adds quilt blocks, sashing, borders, and a bed drop to a finished size in inches and centimetres.
- [Filament Weight to Length](https://toolioz.com/maker/filament-weight-calculator): Converts 3D-printer filament grams to metres using published material density and diameter.
- [3D Print Cost Calculator](https://toolioz.com/maker/3d-print-cost-calculator): Prices a print from filament mass, printer watts, electricity rate, and optional slicer comments.
- [Epoxy Resin Calculator](https://toolioz.com/maker/epoxy-resin-calculator): Fills a slab, cylinder, oval, or river table and splits the volume into an A:B mix.
- [Candle Wax Calculator](https://toolioz.com/maker/candle-wax-calculator): Estimates soy or paraffin wax and fragrance load from container volume in ounces.
- [Baking Pan Size Converter](https://toolioz.com/kitchen/baking-pan-size-converter): Scales batter between round, square, rectangular, loaf, and bundt pans by volume.
- [Cups to Grams Converter](https://toolioz.com/kitchen/cups-to-grams): Converts cups and grams for flour, butter, sugar, rice, and other baking ingredients.
- [Sourdough Hydration Calculator](https://toolioz.com/kitchen/sourdough-hydration-calculator): Turns baker’s percentages into flour, water, starter, and salt weights.
- [Coffee Ratio Calculator](https://toolioz.com/kitchen/coffee-ratio-calculator): Sets pour-over, French press, cold brew, and espresso ratios in grams.
- [Cake Serving Calculator](https://toolioz.com/kitchen/cake-serving-calculator): Counts party and wedding slices from round or rectangular tiers.
- [BPM to MS Calculator](https://toolioz.com/music/bpm-to-ms-calculator): Converts tempo to delay and reverb times, with tap tempo and note divisions.
- [Chord Transposer](https://toolioz.com/music/chord-transposer): Transposes pasted chord sheets by semitones and shows a capo-friendly chart.
- [Frequency to Note Converter](https://toolioz.com/music/frequency-to-note-converter): Maps hertz to piano notes, cents, and MIDI at A4 = 440 or 432.
- [Video File Size Calculator](https://toolioz.com/music/video-file-size-calculator): Estimates recording size from bitrate and duration, or bitrate from a target size.
- [Aquarium Volume Calculator](https://toolioz.com/home/aquarium-volume-calculator): Finds litres and gallons for rectangular, bowfront, cylinder, hexagon, and corner tanks.
- [Board Feet Calculator](https://toolioz.com/home/board-feet-calculator): Counts lumber board feet and log scale with Doyle, Scribner, and International ¼″.
- [Wallpaper Calculator](https://toolioz.com/home/wallpaper-calculator): Estimates rolls with pattern repeat, straight match, or half-drop.
- [Miter Angle Calculator](https://toolioz.com/home/miter-angle-calculator): Finds polygon, picture-frame, and compound crown-molding miter and bevel angles.
- [Resistor Color Code Calculator](https://toolioz.com/electronics/resistor-color-code-calculator): Reads 4, 5, and 6 band resistors and converts a value back to colors.
- [LED Resistor Calculator](https://toolioz.com/electronics/led-resistor-calculator): Sizes a series resistor for LEDs and solves a two-resistor voltage divider.
- [Roman Numeral Date Converter](https://toolioz.com/converters/roman-numeral-date): Converts dates to Roman numerals with a tattoo-style preview and PNG export.
- [Morse Code Translator](https://toolioz.com/converters/morse-code-translator): Encodes and decodes Morse, then plays the pattern as audio in the browser.
- [Barbell Plate Calculator](https://toolioz.com/converters/barbell-plate-calculator): Splits a target weight across plates on a kg or lb bar and draws the loaded bar.

## Site Specifications & Agent Endpoints

Machine-readable manifests and alternate endpoints for AI assistants, LLMs, and research agents.

- [Full LLMs Documentation](https://toolioz.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive markdown knowledge base with formulas and workflows
- [Sitemap XML](https://toolioz.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL sitemap index
- [Privacy Policy](https://toolioz.com/privacy-policy): Privacy guarantees and client-side processing architecture
